findings.evidence: The baseline uses `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all` and `git diff --stat`, while step 7 says 'Flag any change other than the chosen plan file'. Editing an already-untracked file leaves its status unchanged and produces no diffstat; edits to an already-dirty tracked file can also preserve the same diffstat. Those branches can therefore produce identical snapshots despite source changes.
findings.fix: Capture a per-path content/state baseline for tracked and non-ignored untracked files, including index state, before the handoff. Recompute it afterward and compare added, removed and changed paths, exempting only the chosen plan file. If content-level verification is unavailable, explicitly report existing dirty and untracked files as unverified rather than treating an unchanged status/diffstat snapshot as sufficient.
